Hi Jane / John —

Thanks again for taking the call this morning. Per our discussion I’m attaching the draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and the initial MSA redlines we received from your legal team. Key items we covered:

- Milestone: Finalize MSA/DPA/SLA redlines
- Responsibility: ACME legal to send consolidated redlines; Redwood to own counter-redline review and produce a tracked MSA within 3 business days of receiving consolidated redlines
- Target close date for legal review: 2025-07-15 (on track if both sides adhere to turnaround times)
- Dependencies: ACME decision on data residency for DPA, finalization of SLA availability targets, and procurement PO timeline

Actions we agreed:
1) ACME legal to consolidate comments and send a single PDF with redlines -> legal@acme.com (Jane)
2) Redwood (Rafael) to produce an internal consolidated counter-redline and send to ACME within 3 business days of receipt
3) Procurement (John) to confirm PO timing and whether a limited-term pilot is acceptable for initial billing

I’ve attached: ACME_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.docx and the first-pass ACME_MSA_redlines.pdf you shared on the call.

Please confirm owners & turnaround times below so I can update the MAP and circulate an updated version by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks —

Thanks for the recap and for consolidating the MAP. Quick clarifications from legal:

- We will consolidate our redlines into a single PDF and flag the high-priority items (data residency, security liability caps, and termination SLA).
- Expect our consolidated redlines by EOD Wednesday 2025-07-02 (we have an internal review tomorrow morning).

Folks — quick note from the ops/leadership side. I’m copying Lauren (VP, Customer Success) for SLA sign-off. A couple of operational commitments to add to the MAP:

- SLA negotiation turnaround: Redwood agrees to the 3 business day initial counter-redline window Rafael proposed. For exceptions, we’ll communicate expected additional days when escalation occurs.
- Availability SLA targets: we’ll tentatively propose 99.9% for the pilot evaluation period and move to a higher SLA in Dedicated deployment; exact wording + remedies to be negotiated in the SLA doc.
- Audit artifacts: we will provide SOC 2 Type II report and a supplemental attestation for pilot use. Full SOC review keys will require an NDA / executed DPA.

Marissa — please reflect these commitments in the MAP with the escalation path Rafael described. Lauren, if you can confirm the 99.9% pilot SLA is acceptable from CS perspective, we’ll put tentative language in and mark as "subject to final SLA doc."
